identity.title: [v0.91.8][runtime-v3][tls] Add stable rcgen local TLS bootstrap

values.summary: Implemented a repo-native Runtime v3 local TLS bootstrap command using rcgen, explicit managed_external/local_self_signed configuration, durable state-root-scoped certificate reuse, explicit replacement, rustls validation, and local trust documentation.

actual_validation.purpose: Prove the touched adl-runtime crate has no Rust or Clippy warnings across targets.

Prove rcgen local self-signed TLS bootstrap, rustls acceptance, stable restart reuse, restrictive key persistence, concurrent exclusion, explicit replacement, failed replacement preservation, externally managed preservation, and missing-mode fail-closed behavior.
Prove rustfmt and textual diff hygiene for the touched Runtime v3 local TLS files and docs.
